subject: Staying connected on future AI collaboration
draft:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for closing out this chapter — and thanks for the time spent on the Voice AI conversation while it was active. Working through it with you and the HeyGen team was genuinely useful, and I’d still count it as a good step forward.

Even if this isn’t the right moment, I see a few ways we could pick this back up later:
• Apartment AI use cases with relatable AI avatars for leasing follow-ups
• Internal training workflows with consistent multilingual agents
• Short-form campaign creators that scale across markets without reshooting assets

If it makes sense, I’m happy to keep the channel light: feel free to browse our newest AI services at https://ziontechgroup.com, or jump straight to the AI services section at https://ziontechgroup.com/ai-services. We also publish a lot of free tools and resources on https://ziontechgroup.com if you want to see what we’re shipping day to day.

And if you ever want a hard-deadline restart, you can book a call directly here: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup.

Wishing you and the team a great rest of the quarter.

Kleber
CEO, Zion Tech Group
